predecessors.name: Visigothic Kingdom
predecessors.text: Baetica, whose rebellion under Hermenegild the Liuvigild page dates 579-584

successors.name: Visigothic Kingdom
successors.text: Baetica, whose rebellion under Hermenegild the Liuvigild page dates 579-584

ledger.x: 580: Hermenegild, governor of the south, rebels against his father Liuvigild.
584: Seville falls to a siege and the revolt is over.

wars.name: Revolt of Hermenegild
wars.outcome: Liuvigild takes Merida (582) and Seville (584); Hermenegild is imprisoned and executed on 13 April 585.

certainty.note: The pages name Seville, Cordoba and Baetica but no frontier.
